_readme: Tagged from Parsed_PDF_Question_Bank_CA_Inter_Accounts/parsed-RTP-May2026.md using the lean-index schema (see TAGGING-SCHEMA.md). This RTP is unusually broad - it deliberately touches nearly every chapter once, one question each - so it added the most new topic-index.json stubs of the three sittings tagged so far (AS17 Segment Reporting, plus reuse of AS16/AS28/AS18/AS5/AS24/AS7/AS22/AS25/AS15 stubs added while tagging the other two sittings). The RTP's own chapter-heading labels in the source (e.g. 'AS 7 Construction Contracts' above Question 10) occasionally mislabel the actual content being tested - flagged per-question below where that happens.
